title: National Partnership Emails — 2016
notes: The archive explicitly describes expectations of NP participation and encourages members to obtain denominational committee positions.
Kessler identifies the 2016 Missouri racial-reconciliation overture as a revised Sean Lucas version and recommends concrete presbytery tactics to advance it.
The archive strongly supports forming the Women Serving in Ministry study committee and records discussion that some NP participants favored ordaining women as deacons while others did not.
Named committee placements and candidate recommendations are kept as separate evidence types.
